tmd.description: Syntax highlighting, snippets, and language configuration for TMD (Timebase Mark Down)
tmd.commands.openMidiPlayer: Play Score in Web MIDI Player
tmd.commands.refactorOptimizeGrid: Refactor: Optimize Grid Resolution (Minimal Redundant Grid)
tmd.commands.refactorInlineOrders: Refactor: Unroll / Inline Orders to Linear Score
tmd.chat.description: TMD (Timebase Mark Down) musical composition, arranging, and verification assistant.
tmd.chat.check.description: Inspect measure consistency, beat calculations, and syntax in TMD score.
tmd.chat.inspect.description: Inspect song musical profile, vocal tessitura/range, and arrangement density.
tmd.chat.compose.description: Compose, harmonize, or orchestrate TMD musical sections and tracks.
tmd.chat.fix.description: Diagnose and fix measure length discrepancies or syntax issues in TMD score.
tmd.chat.explain.description: Explain score structure, music theory, chord progressions, or Solfege in TMD.
tmd.tools.check.modelDescription: Validates a TMD score text or file for measure length consistency, beat calculation mismatches, and undefined section references.
tmd.tools.inspect.modelDescription: Inspects and profiles a TMD song: vocal pitch range/tessitura, key modulations, section timing/structure, chord vocabulary, and arrangement density.
tmd.tools.format.modelDescription: Formats TMD score code with standard indentation, clean spacing, and uniform layout.
tmd.tools.spec.modelDescription: Returns the authoritative TMD language specification, jianpu scale degree mappings, rhythm grid rules, and human composition principles.
tmd.config.executablePath: Custom path to the tmd command line tool. If empty, the extension looks for 'tmd' in the system PATH.
tmd.config.checkOnSave: Automatically check measure consistency on save and display diagnostics in the Problems panel.
tmd.config.checkOnChange: Automatically check measure consistency as you type (debounced) and update the Problems panel.
